what_is_seen:
They will see the text of the passages found, a few per search, the document's name (without its folders) and the library's name; not your files themselves, nor where they are on this PC. But search after search, an open library can be read passage by passage. Each search is recorded in the Network view.

To hide a folder or a document, close it first (crossed-out eye button, shown on hover in the content).
closed_by: Closed to searches along with the folder “{folder}”
closed_self: Closed to searches: never shown to other machines' searches
close_hint: Close to searches: never shown to other machines' searches
closed_done: “{path}” is closed to searches: no search from another machine will see it.
everyone_not_yet: “Everyone” will come with phase 3 (unknown machines): not yet.
local_only: This library is kept on this PC: it is never searchable. Remove the lock first.
path_not_found: “{path}” is not in this library: nothing to close.
